raw_text: [[File:{{{Alt}}}|28px|link=]] "Flings flakes at the closest Defenses to freeze them" Contents 1 Summary 2 Strategies 3 Statistics 4 History Summary [ ] The Frost Flake is the third Epic piece of Hero Equipment for the Royal Champion . It made its debut in the Meltdown Mayhem event starting December 8, 2025. The Frost Flake appears a blue ice flake with spikes covering the edges. When activated, the Frost Flake will send a number of ice flakes simultaneously to a number of defenses nearest to the Royal Champion. Each flake does a small amount of damage on impact and freezes the target for a few seconds. If there are not enough defenses to target, non-defensive buildings as well as defending troops can be targeted. The flakes can hit air units. Only one ice flake can hit a given target. If there are insufficient targets, the excess flakes will be wasted. In addition to the ability, the Frost Flake gives the Royal Champion additional hitpoints. Strategies [ ] The Frost Flake allows Royal Champion to fill a more supportive role unlike the others, which mostly only make herself more effective. With it, she can stay behind the main army and activate Frost Flake to freeze a high power compartment. Its effect is comparable to the Eternal Tome , temporarily minimizing incoming damage, but slightly weaker as it cannot prevent all damage from other defenses still in range and traps, and does not last as long. Because of this, it is not the most effective Equipment for Royal Champion Charge, as the passive Hero Boost does no provide any damage increases to make her deal with defenses faster, and the short freeze time will not provide more value than the ability of the Haste Vial or Rocket Spear during the charge, while both of them also provide passive damage per second increases. There are different interactions when pairing this with other Hero Equipment: When paired with the Seeking Shield , there are some anti-synergy as the Shield also target the closest defenses, potentially wasting some of the ice flakes freezes. It is outclassed by the pairing with Haste Vial or Rocket Spear as it spreads out the power of Royal Champion's damage boost from the ability over time instead of a burst, while Rocket Spear also allows her to stay back when supporting the main army, keeping her safer with the extra max health provided by Frost Flake. When paired with the Electro Boots , the role of the Royal Champion is still backend support instead of doing a charge with reasons stated above. The main reason to still use it is the self healing, providing health over the course of the raid while she supports the army, with the passive aura damage being a bonus.
